name: Inashiro Mikoto
source: She is the avatar of both the White Rabbit of Inaba and Tsukuyomi, one of the three children of Izanagi and Izanami, the creator gods of Shinto mythology.  She is something of a mischief-maker, teasing Takuto and some others, but this is just an outward expression of her loneliness and somewhat dependent personality.
